To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) the use of a wide range, including both soft and hard constraints, improves the performance of the coreference resolution system; (2) the use of lexical features for resolving bridging cases is beneficial for performance; (3) the use of syntactic information is beneficial for performance, especially in the presence of bridging; (4) the use of discourse information (e.g. discourse markers) is beneficial for performance in the presence of coreference chains that span more than two sentences;

1) the use of soft constraints and a maximum entropy model is beneficial for noun phrase coreference resolution in German; 2) the use of bridging resolution in the form of a lexical model is beneficial for German noun phrase coreference; 3) a combination of soft and hard constraints, as well as lexical information, is beneficial for German coreference resolution.

(i) a wide range of lexical, syntactic, and morphosyntactic features can be used to resolve coreference in German newspaper text, (ii) these features can be used as hard or soft constraints, and (iii) a wide range in weights for soft constraints can be learned automatically from data, and (iv) the resulting system outperforms a state of the-art system for coreference resolution on German newspaper text.

the use of a maximum entropy model is a very promising approach, and that the combination of a wide range (more than 50) of features is necessary for good performance.
a wide variety of features are useful in coreference resolution, but that the most effective features are those that are specific to the particular task at hand.

we have shown the usefulness of a constraint-based approach for the resolution of nominal noun phrase coreference, and that we can achieve state-of-the-art results with a simple, robust, and easily extendable approach.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the combination of hard constraints with a maximum entropy classifier is very useful for resolving cases of nominal coreference in German.
a constraint-based approach is very useful for coreference resolution, and can be used to achieve good results without the need for a complex feature extraction process.

, in the context of a coreference resolution system for German, the use of a wide range and variety of constraints, including both lexical information as well as syntactic features, is a promising approach to the resolution of coreferent nominal phrases.
